questions.question:
Arrange the following words in a meaningful order:

1. Promotion

2. Birth

3. Job

4. Retirement

5. Education
questions.solution:
The hierarchical order of our life is as follows:

Birth is the very first step of life.

Birth < Education < Job < Promotion < Retirement.

Hence, the correct order is **"2, 5, 3, 1, 4"**.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusion carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it approves to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

All locks are keys

Some keys are doors

**Conclusions:**

I. Some locks are door.

II. No lock is a door

III. No key is door

options.text: Only conclusion I and II follow.
Only Conclusions II and III follow.
Either conclusion I or II follows.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
According to the given information, the least possible diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f36eb050b763d6c45bdc3841ddcefc47f6cb1dd8b3acf4a3dfec480061cf3a4.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some locks are door --> False (As "All locks are keys" and "Some keys are Door" there is no relation between locks and door so we can't say "Some locks are door")

II. No lock is a door --> False (As "All locks are keys" and "Some keys are Door" there is no relation between locks and door so we can't say "No lock is a door")

III. No key is door --> False (As "Some keys are door" so "No key is door" is definitely false)

Conclusion I and II forms complementary pairs.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Either conclusion I or II follows"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Complementary pairs are such pairs that have subject-predicate common but their conclusions are not definitely true.

 

 
 

 **Complementary Pairs:**
 
 

 Some + No
 
 

 All + Some not

questions.question: The average of the ages of A, B and C , 3 years ago was 45 years, and that of B and C 4 years ago was 35 years. Find the age of A after 4 years.
questions.solution:
Given,

Average age of A, B and C, 3 years ago = 45

Average age of A, B and C at present = 45 + 3 =48

Sum of ages of A, B and C (A + B + C) = 48 × 3 = 144

Given,

Average age of B and C, 4 years ago = 35

Average age of B and C at present = 35 + 4 = 39

Sum of ages of B and C (B + C) = 39 × 2 = 78

Age of A at present= (A + B + C) - (B + C)

= 144 - 78

= 66

Age of A after 4 years = 66 + 4 = 70 years.

So, the age of A, after 4 years is **70 years**.

Hence, the correct answer is **70**.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given set of numbers.

**(2, 57, 7)**
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is :

(First number)³ + (Third number)² = Second number.

**(2, 57, 7)**

**2³ + 7² = 8 + 49 = 57.**

(4, 55, 9)

4³ + 9² = 64 + 81 = 145 ≠ 55.

**(5, 129, 2)**

**5³ + 2² = 125 + 4 = 129.**

(1, 15, 4)

1³ + 4² = 1 + 16 = 17 ≠ 15.

(3, 25, 6)

3³ + 6² = 27 + 36 = 63 ≠ 25.

So, (5, 129, 2) shares the same relationship as in (2, 57, 7).

questions.question:
Directions: Read the information given below carefully and answer the questions accordingly:

Shardul walked 31 m towards the south to reach the internet centre and then took a left turn and walked 55 m to reach the bus station. Again, he took a left turn and walked 31 m. Finally, he turned to his right and walked 18 m and stopped. How far and in which direction is shardul from the starting point ?
questions.solution:
Drawing the diagram according to given information :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75b71e85edf3a95422d3c1a170705dc7f4c0656a34269a5a2c75e3ad1ca09969.png] 

S is the starting point of Shardul.

O is the end point of Shardul.

Distance between S and O = SO.

SO = (ST + TO) m

SO = (55 + 18) m

**SO = 73 m.**

Shardul is facing towards **East.**

Shardul is in East direction 73 m far from starting point.

Hence, the correct answer is **"73 m, east".**

Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given set of numbers.

(6, 8, 34)
questions.solution:
The Logic follows here is:

**Logic: First number ×** **(First number + 1) - Second number = Third number** 

Now,

(6, 8, 34)

→ 6 × (6 + 1) - 8

→ 6 × 7 - 8

→ 42 - 8 = 34.

Similarly, **(3, 2, 10)**

**→ 3 × (3 + 1) - 2**

**→ 3 × 4 - 2**

**→ 12 - 2 = 10.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
